info.title: API.SH: Goodreads
info.description: The Goodreads API from API.SH: public Goodreads data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodreads-book

parameters.description: Book URL or Goodreads id, with or without the slug.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: `similar` adds `similar_books` (costs more).

get.description:
The Listopia lists that contain a book, as its "Lists" page shows them: list id, title, link, the book's rank in the list, the list's book and voter counts, and sample covers. Every edition of the book comes from `/goodreads/v1/editions`. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodreads-book-lists

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A goodreads.com/book/show/<id> link, or the book id such as 44767458 or 44767458-dune.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, starting at 1.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The Goodreads Choice Awards. Without `category`: every category of that year with its winning book. With `category`: that category's nominees ranked by readers' votes (title, author, votes, book id, cover).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodreads-choice-awards

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Award year, 2009 or later (default: the latest finished year).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category slug from the list, e.g. fiction, historical-fiction, mystery-thriller, romance, romantasy, fantasy, science-fiction, horror, young-adult-fantasy, debut-novel, nonfiction, memoir-autobiography, history-biography, humor.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.title: Readers' Favorite Fiction 2024 — Goodreads Choice Awards

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Giveaways per page (max 50).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Paging cursor from the previous page.

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

parameters.name: work
parameters.description: Goodreads work id of a book (the number in its /work/quotes/ link).

parameters.name: tag
parameters.description: Quote tag, e.g. love, fear, philosophy.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words to find in quotes.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

get.description:
Pagination: pass the cursor from `next_cursor` on the previous response; `next_cursor` is null on the last page. Filter with `rating`, `language` and `text_search`, and order with `sort`; a filtered listing answers `applied_filters`, and its `next_cursor` keeps the filters.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodreads-reviews

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor from `next_cursor` on the previous response; `next_cursor` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this star rating (1 to 5).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: `default` (the site's order), `newest` or `oldest`.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Only reviews in this language (ISO code such as `en` or `es`).

parameters.name: text_search
parameters.description: Only reviews containing these words (100 characters max).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Goodreads books (default), authors, groups or quotes, as the site's search tabs offer. Books: title, link, author(s), rating, ratings count, published year, editions; `field` narrows a book search to title, author or genre. Authors: the authors of the books an author search finds (name, link, id, matching books). Groups (10 a page): name, link, members, last activity, topics, description. Quotes: text, author, book, likes, tags. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/goodreads-search

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to search (books, authors, groups, quotes; default books).

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: For type=books, the field to match (all, title, author, genre; default all).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
